evidence.observation: All five UI tests passed, then exact comparison found 14,586 changed pixels confined to 003-smart-rewind-applied.png.

entries.rootCause: The Smart Rewind capture was not gated on the acknowledged rewind state, so the transient notice could be captured before its semantic presentation was settled.

fix.summary: Replace polling and capture-time pixel sampling with an event-driven Smart Rewind state probe, then capture only after the semantic predicate succeeds.
